## Background

I am an agronomist and soil scientist who works at the intersection of microbial ecology and soil biogeochemistry. I’m always eager to discuss sustainable agriculture over a cup of coffee! ☕

## CV

You can download my CV [here](files/CV_Guilherme_Lucio_Martins_2026) with the description of my education, working experience, and publications.

## Skills

Throughout my academic career I have taken part in a range of studies that
shaped a broad methodological portfolio, spanning soil and environmental
chemistry, molecular microbial ecology, bioinformatics, and applied statistics.

### Soil chemistry and fertility
- Soil fertility analysis: plant-available macro- and micronutrients by
  ion-exchange resin and DTPA extraction (van Raij et al., 1997; EMBRAPA
  methods).
- Soil phosphorus fractionation (Hedley et al., 1982): sequential extraction
  separating labile, moderately labile, organic, non-labile and residual P pools.
- Soil carbon fractionation into particulate organic matter (POM) and
  mineral-associated organic matter (MAOM) following Cambardella & Elliott (1992).
- Total C and N and their stable isotopes (δ¹³C, δ¹⁵N) in soil and plant
  samples.

### Dissolved organic matter
- Extraction and quantification of dissolved organic carbon (DOC).
- Dissolved organic matter (DOM) isolation by solid-phase extraction (PPL
  cartridges) and molecular characterization by high-resolution mass
  spectrometry.
- Molecular formula assignment with the MFAssignR package and compositional
  classification of DOM using van Krevelen diagrams.

### Organic residues and fertilizers
- Composting of organic residues, including animal manures and
  agro-industrial by-products.
- Characterization of organic fertilizers following USEPA methods 3051A and
  6010: pH; total organic carbon by dry combustion and wet oxidation
  (Walkley–Black); total nitrogen by Kjeldahl digestion; labile macronutrients
  (P, K, Ca, Mg, S) and micronutrients (Fe, Mn, Zn, Cu, B) by calcium-acetate
  and microwave-assisted digestion.

### Plant analyses
- Total carbon and nitrogen in plant tissue by dry combustion.
- Nitric–perchloric acid digestion of plant tissue for elemental
  quantification.

### Soil biology and microbial ecology (bench)
- DNA extraction from soil, litter, plant tissue and organic residues.
- Phospholipid fatty acid (PLFA) extraction and assignment to microbial
  functional groups.
- Soil enzyme activity assays: β-glucosidase (Eivazi & Tabatabai, 1988),
  acid phosphatase and arylsulfatase (Tabatabai & Bremner, 1969, 1970).
- Microcosm incubation experiments on pesticide mineralization using a
  dilution-to-extinction approach with ¹⁴C-labelled molecules.

### Bioinformatics
- Amplicon sequencing analysis of the 16S rRNA gene and the fungal ITS region
  (DADA2 pipeline).
- Functional prediction from amplicon data with PICRUSt2.
- Fungal functional guild assignment with FUNGuild and FungalTraits.
- Shotgun metagenomics: quality control (FastQC, Trimmomatic), read merging
  (PEAR), contig assembly (MEGAHIT), ORF prediction (Prodigal), taxonomic
  annotation (Kraken2) and functional annotation against biogeochemical-cycle
  databases, including PCycDB (phosphorus) and dbCAN (carbohydrate-active
  enzymes).

### Biostatistics and data analysis
- Univariate analysis: ANOVA, Pearson and Spearman correlation.
- Multivariate and community analysis: PERMANOVA, ordination (PCoA, NMDS,
  RDA), alpha-diversity indices and co-occurrence network analysis.
- Differential abundance analysis: ALDEx2, LinDA and MaAsLin2.
- Modelling: linear mixed-effects models (LMM), random forest for regression
  and classification, structural equation modelling (piecewiseSEM, lavaan) and
  partial least squares path modelling (PLS-PM).

### Experimental design and field work
- Greenhouse experiments with maize, soybean and tree seedlings.
- Experimental design and analysis for completely randomized and randomized
  complete block designs.
- Planning and execution of field sampling campaigns for soil, litter and
  plant material.

### Analytical instrumentation
- **ICP-OES** — multi-element quantification in digested organic fertilizers
  and residues.
- **Atomic absorption spectrophotometry (AAS)** — macro- and micronutrients in
  soil extracts and digested plant tissue.
- **EA-IRMS (Delta Plus)** — total C and N with stable isotope ratios
  (δ¹³C, δ¹⁵N) in soil and plant samples.
- **LECO elemental analyzer** — total C and N by dry combustion.
- **High-resolution mass spectrometry (Orbitrap Elite)** — molecular-level
  characterization of dissolved organic matter.
- **GC-FID and GC-MS** — PLFA quantification and peak identification.
- **TOC-V<sub>CPN</sub> (Shimadzu)** — dissolved and total organic carbon.
- **Liquid scintillation spectroscopy** — ¹⁴CO₂ quantification in
  radioisotope-based mineralization assays.
- **Microwave-assisted digestion systems** — sample preparation under USEPA
  3051A.
- **UV-Vis spectrophotometry** — colorimetric endpoints in soil enzyme assays
  and phosphorus fractionation.
